corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 5th-order loop (ሬ), forming the standard Ge'ez construct state መፍቀሬ ('lover of', explaining the etymology of Philadelphia).

corrections.corrected_text: ነው ፡ በሱ ፡ አምነው ፡ ላሉ ፡ ጽፈህ ፡ ስ
corrections.reason: The printed glyph in ጽፈህ is clearly ህ (U-shaped), not ሕ.
The printed glyph is 4th-order ፋ (አፋ, an Amharic term for a royal sash/girdle translating ቅናት), without a 2nd-order side stroke.
